newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish politician believed kidnapped by ETA.
newsitem.headline: Spanish politician believed kidnapped by ETA.

text.p: Spanish police said they feared a town councillor in the Basque region had been kidnapped by ETA Basque separatists following a call in the name of the group received by a newspaper on Thursday, police said.

The caller told a director at the Basque newspaper Egin, ETA's usual mouthpiece, that Popular Party politician Miguel Angel Blanco would be killed in 48 hours if the government did not change its prison policy.
The Interior Ministry later confirmed that Blanco had been kidnapped, state radio said.

ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) has been pushing the Popular Party government to move imprisoned members to jails in the Basque region. Under a long-standing policy, they are scattered around the country.
Last week, the separatists released a kidnapped businessman and hours later Spanish police rescued a prison worker who had been ETA's longest hostage.
ETA, which has killed some 800 people in its nearly 30-year drive for Basque independence, had kidnapped the prison worker to pressure the government on its prison policy.
